sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Voltures are aggressive enemies found in the Ashlands. Volture nests will spawn Voltures one time. Voltures can also be found flying above the water along the Ashlands coast.

table_data.Type: Anywhere in the Ashlands at very low altitudes (e.g. at sea)

sections.heading: Attacks and abilities
sections.text:
Voltures will attempt to get behind the player and attack with their talons. If the player turns toward the Volture to attack it, it will attempt to fly up in the air can get behind the player again. Additionally, Voltures are among the fastest enemies in the game and can outrun a player in light armor with the full effect of Wind Run, making them especially dangerous to players with very low health.
Voltures deal little damage and do not have very much health, but their speed and tendency to get behind the player can make them a nuisance (and a threat in larger numbers). Care should be taken when fighting other enemies when nearby Voltures, since the latter can potentially get behind the player and block them in.

sections.heading: Talons
sections.text: Draws back before lunging forward to scratch the player with both claws (110 Slash damage). This attack hits in a 1.5-meter 60.99-degree horizontal arc. It can be used every 2 seconds within 1.5 meters of a player.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The name "Volture" is a portmanteau of "volcano" and "vulture".
• They are one of the few enemies that are afraid of fire, together with Boars, Necks, Greylings, Greydwarfs, Bears and Viles.

sections.heading: Note
sections.text: • Voltures take damage from boiling water around Ashlands despite being native there.

Introduction. Voltures are aggressive enemies found in the Ashlands. Volture nests will spawn Voltures one time. Voltures can also be found flying above the water along the Ashlands coast.

Attacks and abilities. Voltures will attempt to get behind the player and attack with their talons. If the player turns toward the Volture to attack it, it will attempt to fly up in the air can get behind the player again. Additionally, Voltures are among the fastest enemies in the game and can outrun a player in light armor with the full effect of Wind Run, making them especially dangerous to players with very low health.
Voltures deal little damage and do not have very much health, but their speed and tendency to get behind the player can make them a nuisance (and a threat in larger numbers). Care should be taken when fighting other enemies when nearby Voltures, since the latter can potentially get behind the player and block them in.

Talons. Draws back before lunging forward to scratch the player with both claws (110 Slash damage). This attack hits in a 1.5-meter 60.99-degree horizontal arc. It can be used every 2 seconds within 1.5 meters of a player.

Trivia. • The name "Volture" is a portmanteau of "volcano" and "vulture".
• They are one of the few enemies that are afraid of fire, together with Boars, Necks, Greylings, Greydwarfs, Bears and Viles.

Note. • Voltures take damage from boiling water around Ashlands despite being native there.
